content: 1. Avoid or use an alternative drug when co-administering neratinib with strong or moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors, as these can increase neratinib levels or effects. 2. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of nirogacestat by inhibiting hepatic and intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 3. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of olaparib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If co-administration with strong CYP3A inhibitors is unavoidable, reduce the olaparib dose to 150 mg (capsule) or 100 mg (tablet) twice daily. Do not substitute tablets with capsules. 4. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of omaveloxolone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If unavoidable, reduce the omaveloxolone dose to 50 mg/day. Monitor closely and discontinue if adverse effects occur. 5. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of ombitasvir/paritaprevir/ritonavir by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 6. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of ombitasvir/paritaprevir/ritonavir and dasabuvir (DSC) by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 7. Posaconazole and ondansetron both prolong the QTc interval. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Avoid in patients with congenital long QT syndrome. ECG monitoring is recommended with concomitant medications that prolong QT interval, electrolyte abnormalities, CHF, or bradyarrhythmias. Posaconazole may increase ondansetron levels. 8. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of osimertinib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Avoid co-administration of osimertinib with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. If no alternative exists, monitor the patient closely for adverse effects. 9. Oxaliplatin and posaconazole both prolong the QTc interval. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 10. Posaconazole increases oxycodone levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Oxycodone dose reduction may be warranted when co-administered with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. 11. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of palbociclib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If unavoidable, reduce the palbociclib dose to 75 mg/day. 12. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of palovarotene by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 13. Posaconazole and panobinostat both prolong the QTc interval. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Panobinostat significantly prolongs the QT interval, and its prescribing information advises against use with drugs that prolong QTc. 14. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of pazopanib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If co-administration is necessary, reduce the pazopanib dose to 400 mg/day. 15. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of pemigatinib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If co-administration with strong or moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors is unavoidable, reduce the pemigatinib dose as per the drug monograph. After discontinuing the CYP3A4 inhibitor for three elimination half-lives, resume the previous pemigatinib dose. 16. Pentamidine and posaconazole both prolong the QTc interval. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 17. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of pexidartinib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If co-administration with strong or moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors is unavoidable, reduce the pexidartinib dose as per the drug monograph. After discontinuing the CYP3A4 inhibitor for three elimination half-lives, resume the previous pexidartinib dose. 18. Phenytoin decreases posaconazole levels by inducing P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 19. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of pimavanserin by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Decrease the pimavanserin dose to 17 mg/day if co-administered with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. 20. Pimozide and posaconazole both prolong the QTc interval. Posaconazole increases pimozide levels by decreasing its metabolism. This combination is contraindicated due to the risk of QT interval prolongation. 21. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of pirtobrutinib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If co-administration is unavoidable, reduce the pirtobrutinib dose by 50 mg. If the current dose is 50 mg daily, discontinue pirtobrutinib during the use of strong CYP3A inhibitors. After discontinuing the inhibitor for five half-lives, resume the previous pirtobrutinib dose. 22. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of pitolisant by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 23. Posaconazole increases pomalidomide levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism and P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 24. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of ponatinib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Reduce the ponatinib starting dose to 30 mg daily if co-administration with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors cannot be avoided. 25. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of pralsetinib by inhibiting CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If unavoidable, reduce the pralsetinib dose as per its prescribing information. After discontinuing the inhibitor, resume the previous pralsetinib dose. 26. Posaconazole and procainamide both prolong the QTc interval. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 27. Posaconazole increases quinidine levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated due to the risk of QT interval prolongation. Quinidine also increases posaconazole levels via P-glycoprotein inhibition. 28. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of ranolazine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 29. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of red yeast rice by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. This combination may increase creatine kinase levels and the risk of myopathy or rhabdomyolysis, as red yeast rice contains monacolin K, which is chemically identical to lovastatin. 30. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of repotrectinib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism and P-glycoprotein. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 31. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of ribociclib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If co-administration with a strong CYP3A inhibitor is necessary, reduce the ribociclib starting dose to 400 mg/day. 32. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of rifabutin by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 33. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of rimegepant by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism and P-glycoprotein. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 34. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of riociguat by decreasing its metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Monitor for signs of hypotension and reduce the dose if needed. 35. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of rivaroxaban by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 36. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of ruxolitinib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Reduce the ruxolitinib starting dose to 10 mg twice daily if platelet count is ≥100 x 10^9/L and co-administered with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. Avoid use if platelet counts are <100 x 10^9/L. 37. Posaconazole decreases the effects of Saccharomyces boulardii by an unspecified interaction mechanism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Systemic or oral antifungals may decrease probiotic activity. 38. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of selpercatinib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 39. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of selumetinib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If co-administration with strong or moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors is unavoidable, reduce the selumetinib dose as per its monograph. After discontinuing the inhibitor for three elimination half-lives, resume the previous selumetinib dose. 40. Posaconazole and sevoflurane both prolong the QTc interval. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 41. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of silodosin by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 42. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of siponimod by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Siponimod and posaconazole both prolong the QTc interval. 43. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of sirolimus by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 44. Solifenacin and posaconazole both prolong the QTc interval. This combination is contraindicated. 45. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of sonidegib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Avoid co-administration of sonidegib with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. 46. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of sorafenib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 47. Posaconazole and sotalol both prolong the QTc interval. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 48. Sotrasib decreases posaconazole levels by inducing P-glycoprotein. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If unavoidable, refer to the prescribing information of the P-gp substrate for dosage modifications. 49. Posaconazole and sparsentan may increase each other's toxicity through pharmacodynamic synergy. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If unavoidable, interrupt sparsentan treatment. When resuming sparsentan, consider dose titration. 50. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of stiripentol by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 51. Posaconazole increases the levels of suvorexant by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Suvorexant is not recommended with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. 52. Tacrolimus and posaconazole both prolong the QTc interval. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 53. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of tamsulosin by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 54. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of tazemetostat by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 55. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of teniposide by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 56. Tepotinib increases posaconazole levels by inhibiting P-glycoprotein. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If co-administration is unavoidable, reduce the P-gp substrate dosage as recommended in its product labeling. 57. Tetrabenazine and posaconazole both prolong the QTc interval. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 58. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of tiagabine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 59. Posaconazole increases the levels of tofacitinib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Reduce the tofacitinib dose to 5 mg daily when co-administered with potent CYP3A4 inhibitors. 60. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of tolvaptan by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 61. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of trabectedin by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If a strong CYP3A inhibitor must be used short-term (e.g., less than 14 days), administer the inhibitor one week after trabectedin infusion and discontinue it the day prior to the next infusion. 62. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of tramadol by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 63. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of trazodone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 64. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of ubrogepant by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 65. Posaconazole increases the toxicity of umeclidinium bromide/vilanterol inhaled by prolonging the QTc interval. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Exercise extreme caution when vilanterol is co-administered with drugs that prolong the QTc interval, as adrenergic agonist effects on the cardiovascular system may be potentiated. 66. Posaconazole and vandetanib both prolong the QTc interval. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Posaconazole increases vandetanib levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. 67. Vemurafenib and posaconazole both prolong the QTc interval. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Concomitant use of vemurafenib with drugs that prolong the QT interval is not recommended.
